tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lede: Work for your side projects. Tasks stay in hiro and never touch Jira. Everything else works the same: questions, coding, your review.
tasks.empty: No tasks in this repository yet.
tasks.reposSub: Your side-project repositories on this server
tasks.help: For repositories only you work on, you can let hiro push straight to main after you approve. It still never pushes without your review.
tasks.drawerSub: For your side projects. Not synced to Jira.

tasks.descPh: Describe the result you want. The clearer this is, the fewer questions hiro asks.
tasks.startAskHint: hiro reads the code and asks before coding. Best for anything unclear.
tasks.startCodeHint: Skip questions. Good for small, well-described tasks.
tasks.repoNeeded: Code and tests need a repository: pick one, or choose another kind.
